resources.string: Shoot from the center, slip blocks into a spiral chain, and pop 3+ color matches.
Active block refreshed for Chain Shift!
Blocks enter from the edge, wrap around the board, and crawl toward the center. Your shooter stays in the middle, so every shot must cut into the moving chain before it reaches you.
Aim from the center and release to shoot. Your block inserts where it hits the chain, pushing subsequent blocks forward.
Match 3 or more connected blocks of the same color along the chain to pop them. When the gap closes, the chain retreats toward the edge, potentially triggering chain reactions.
Stay calm, keep the spiral short, and use your shots to break dangerous runs before they lock the center. The deeper the chain goes, the less room you have to recover.
Start by firing at the highlighted part of the spiral. Your block launches from the center and inserts into the chain at the point of impact.
Now use the guided shot to line up 3 blocks of the same color. Matching segments burst immediately and open breathing room near the center.
This setup rewards a smarter shot. Clear the first match, watch the chain retreat toward the edge, and let the second match pop on its own.
Aim and release to shoot the highlighted block.
